name: Edit Protocol Host Validation Probe
description: Task-local host-side probe for the Cubism 5.4-compat edit API protocol bridge: enables the native external-application service on port 22033, pre-seeds the client token into CExternalAppAuthManager so registration completes unattended, answers the Turboism edit-approval dialog per the task-controlled approval.mode file, and closes the host after the external client publishes terminal evidence.

permissions.reason: Executes the verified EXTERNAL_APP_SETTING typed command to configure and start the host's external-application WebSocket service on port 22033 before the external client connects.
Reads the active document's Undo history snapshot before and after the protocol matrix for restoration evidence.
